Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Florence Mid-Century Modern Wide Open-Back Accent Kitchen Dining Chairs, 18.8"W, Grey, Set of 2
Colors: Grey
Materials: Polyester fabric; Black metal legs
The unique shape of this Mid-century modern chair's open back give it a light, airy feel that works in a dining room, craft room, home office -- anywhere you need an extra seat. It's easy to move between rooms and up and down stairs. Hardwood upholstered with polyester fabric; black metal legs Ideal for any home needing furniture that multi-tasks. 2 chairs to a pack. Assembly in 15 minutes; attach base with 4 screws. Vaccuum, spot clean with damp cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. 18.8"W x 22.8"D x 33.9"H. 18.7" seat height.
